page.overview:
Who is Keiri?

She and Kanpu warned Nonō Yakushi about the orphanage's financial struggles, which only became worse after Kabuto was taken in. She was frustrated by Kabuto's inability to tell time, unaware he needed glasses. Sometime later, when Danzō Shimura came to the orphanage to recruit a new member for Root, Keiri threatened to report Danzō's blackmail to the Third Hokage.

Keiri seemed to get easily frustrated with the children at the orphanage but cared deeply for them. She also wasn't afraid to threaten a higher-up shinobi like Danzō.

Keiri has black hair and black eyes. Her outfit consists of a black gown with white apron and a white coif that covers her hair.
